intro: Outside the lab I read, write and cook. This page is a short, informal account of that.

sections.title: Reading
sections.body: I read mostly literature and philosophy, and I like books that stay with me after the last page. A few I keep returning to:

books.title: Aristotle and Dante Discover the Secrets of the Universe
books.author: Benjamin Alire Sáenz

books.title: Aristotle and Dante Dive into the Waters of the World
books.author: Benjamin Alire Sáenz

sections.title: Writing
sections.body: I write about people, emotions, relationships and the small turns of everyday life: reflections, letters and thoughts that do not fit anywhere else. Some of it is on my blog, [somewherewithin.github.io](https://somewherewithin.github.io/), and I have also written content for [shiningforever.in](https://shiningforever.in/). Neither is fully up to date. I am still working on both and add to them whenever I find the time. At IIT Bombay I also edited for the department's editorial board, where I interviewed alumni about their careers and wrote for the department magazine, newsletters and social media.

sections.title: Cooking
sections.body: I enjoy trying new recipes, ingredients and cuisines. For me cooking is a hands-on way to learn: you change one thing, taste, and find out what happened.
